sloka: तस्य पुत्रद्वयं ब्रह्मन्द्वाभ्यां स्त्रीभ्यामजायत ।अहं श्वेत इति ख्यातो यवीयान्सुरथो ऽभवत् ।। ७.७८.४ ॥
transliteration: tasya putradvayaṁ brahmandvābhyāṁ strībhyāmajāyata ।ahaṁ śveta iti khyāto yavīyānsuratho 'bhavat ।। 7.78.4 ॥

translations.english: O Brahmana, he had two sons born from two wives; I was known as Shveta, and the younger one was Suratha.
